speaker: alse_pinder
text: Look at the caps, sir. Sprigs of sallow. They have put them in for palms.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sallow is as near as the parish comes. I am not taking a sprig.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor is this house. A cap is not a church, and the church has gone without palms these thirty years.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them pass. I have written nothing, and I am not beginning on a doorstep.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The wind is still in the east. It finds the neck.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we walk. I want my table, not a procession.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. The king can finish the way in my head. I am too tired to carry a branch as well.
